gloss: to cut, to sever, to turn off

definitions.gloss: to cut, to sever, to slice
definitions.explanation: To divide something with a sharp instrument.
To stop the operation of a device or end a connection.
To terminate a relationship or connection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{切|き}る。
examples.english: To cut vegetables into small pieces.
I want to go get a haircut.

examples.english: My mother cut the fish into three pieces in the kitchen and shared it with me and my older brother.

⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}って⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: To turn off the lights before sleeping.

notes:
{切|き}る is a fundamental verb with many uses.

TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (intransitive, to be cut, to run out)

CONJUGATION (godan, r-column):
- ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧形: {切|き}らない
- ます形: {切|き}ります
- て形: {切|き}って
- た形: {切|き}った
- 可能形: ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to cut something)
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to hang up the phone)
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to turn off the power)
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to cut ties)
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (deadline expires - intransitive pair)

COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧ (to cut off, to clip out)
- ⟦{切|き}り{開|ひら}く→切り開く：05745_kirihiraku⟧ (to clear, to pioneer)
- ⟦{切|き}り{捨|す}てる→切り捨てる：05747_kirisuteru⟧ (to discard, to truncate)
- ⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧ (to switch, to change over)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}る→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧ (to give up, to resign oneself)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{息|いき}を{切|き}らす→息を切らす：22921_ikiwokirasu⟧ (to be out of breath)
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to commit seppuku; to take responsibility)
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}る (to feel sharp pain)
